stories.title: S1 retained session experience
stories.text: As a session participant I can distinguish committed, provisional and incomplete history, and inspect the exact recorded body without affecting execution.

stories.title: S2 retained session experience
stories.text: As a participant I can keep reading a compact conversation and exact call changes while the terminal resizes and work continues.

stories.title: S3 retained session experience
stories.text: As a keyboard or mouse reader I can find, select, copy and export content and retain all current controls, with real terminal proof.

stories.title: Exact accepted conversation with compact completion
stories.text: As a session participant I see each accepted human prompt and assistant response once, can inspect every exact execution/completion fact, and see uncertainty or errors without duplicated rows or guessed associations.

stories.title: Stable display and consistent user-message styling
stories.text: As a participant I can read every line of a user message in the same intended style and interact with a stable retained terminal display, without changing the familiar layout.

stories.title: See the team currently working
stories.text: As a participant I can see the existing main/fork/subagent status tree while work proceeds without losing composer width. Selecting a target conversation and messaging it remains a separately tracked requirement until implemented.

stories.title: Choose whose conversation I view and message
stories.text: As a participant I can select the main session, a fork or a subagent, read its actual conversation and send to that exact target with an acknowledged result. This remains pending beyond passive status restoration.

stories.title: Choose auxiliary content directly
stories.text: As a participant I can use /pane to toggle the side area and /pane diff or /pane agents to select its actual content. Existing /view commands remain supported. Remembering the new content choice and selecting/viewing/messaging individual agents are explicitly tracked until implemented.

stories.title: Control panes without leaving the draft
stories.text: I can toggle and choose panes directly with visible shortcuts and a thin divider, without losing my draft or sending a request. Implemented and locally verified in preview.6; recorded source d4913e67cdb4fba49ff3e4bf8a6c3656c532f7e8. Main landing and review remain separate.

stories.title: Copy the displayed text I drag across
stories.text: I can visibly select conversation/tool headers, entries and Diff text, and understand whether copied bytes are original source or a captured display snapshot. Implemented and locally verified in preview.6; recorded source d4913e67cdb4fba49ff3e4bf8a6c3656c532f7e8. Main landing and review remain separate.

stories.title: Choose and recover my exact send gesture
stories.text: I can persist Shift+Enter sending, keep bare Enter as newline and explicitly recover with the same keyboard/button policy cycle when terminal reporting is unconfirmed. Implemented and locally verified in preview.6; recorded source d4913e67cdb4fba49ff3e4bf8a6c3656c532f7e8. Main landing and review remain separate.

stories.title: Scroll and return to the latest message explicitly
stories.text: I can keep a stable reading position while work continues, preserve every delivered scroll step and explicitly return to the selected conversation’s latest admitted item. NUI-004 R4 is written and saved in a separate paused, uncompiled tree; actual source-bound App and measurement proof remains pending, and preview.6 excludes it.

stories.title: Know which local preview I can actually use
stories.text: I can distinguish a candidate from my verified installed preview, see its actual feature scope, recover the prior binary and hear Norn updated only after a successful checked local update. Implemented and locally verified in preview.6; recorded source d4913e67cdb4fba49ff3e4bf8a6c3656c532f7e8. Main landing and review remain separate.
